name: Say why a connection is refused
depends_on: WIRE-03; PORT-05
what_it_is: While dragging, compatible ports glow and an incompatible port explains in one line why it cannot connect, with a one-click fix.

name: Port tooltips with type, description and value
depends_on: a description per input (shared with FIND-04)
what_it_is: Hovering any port shows its full name, meaning, type, unit, whether required, and its current value.

name: Mark required and optional inputs
depends_on: PORT-01
what_it_is: Required inputs look different from optional ones and the node states what it still needs.

name: Viewer node and pinned peek
group: Data shapes (lists, trees, paths, matching rules, graft and flatten, data viewers, spreadsheet-like views)
source_programs: Grasshopper 1; Rhino 9 Grasshopper; Dynamo 3.x; Blender 4.x; Sverchok; Unreal Blueprints
depends_on: hover peek; count badges
what_it_is: Pin the hover peek to keep a port's full contents (index, value or type, count, first and last items) open on the canvas; Ctrl+Shift+click opens one.

name: Per-node preview on and off
group: Previews in the drawing and inspection
depends_on: flow's own layer; Show pills
what_it_is: An eye toggle on each node and group decides whether its results draw, with only end-of-chain nodes shown by default.

name: Starter set for new users
depends_on: FIND-03
what_it_is: A curated set of about twenty core nodes grouped by urban-design task, shown first in the library and in an empty search.

name: Add after the selected node and wire it
depends_on: compatibility matching behind wire-drop search; tidy
what_it_is: With one node selected, a node added from search lands downstream and is wired to the first compatible port.

name: Recent and favourite nodes
source_programs: Nuke; Blender 4.x; Node-RED; ComfyUI; Unreal Blueprints
depends_on: FIND-03
what_it_is: Recently used and starred nodes appear first in search and the library, with exact name matches still ranked first.

name: Highlight a node's wires and follow them
depends_on: arrows between nodes (keyboard)
what_it_is: Hovering a port or selecting a node brightens its wires, fades the rest and lets the keyboard jump along them.

name: Extract an input into a value node, and back
depends_on: PORT-01
what_it_is: One click turns an input into a wired value node of the right kind (slider, choice list, text) and folds it back.

name: Full names and plain labels
what_it_is: Nodes and ports show full readable names by default, with a compact mode for experts.

name: Warnings roll up into groups, sub-flows and tools
depends_on: STATE-01; sub-flows; groups; import as a link; flow as a tool
what_it_is: A collapsed sub-flow, group, linked flow or flow-as-tool shows the worst state inside it with a count, and opens the path to the node.

name: Out-of-date marker in manual mode
depends_on: run modes; dependency graph (Live values); count badges
what_it_is: In manual and delay modes, edited nodes and everything downstream are marked stale (hatched strip, greyed badges, stale tag on results) until the next run.

name: Breadcrumb path bar for nested sub-flows
depends_on: CONT-04 Open a sub-flow in place
what_it_is: A path bar at the top of the canvas showing which sub-flow you are in, with clickable levels and back and forward history.

name: Select upstream or downstream and dim the rest
depends_on: rectangle selection; lineage
what_it_is: Extend the selection to everything that feeds, or is fed by, the selected nodes, and optionally fade everything else.

name: Highlight the selected node's results and frame them
group: Previews in the drawing and inspection
depends_on: PREV-03 Per-node preview; Select pills
what_it_is: Selecting a node draws its results in a highlight colour, even if its preview is off, and one key zooms the drawing to them.

name: Pick a shape in the drawing to jump to its node
group: Previews in the drawing and inspection
depends_on: Made-by badge; CONT-04 Open a sub-flow in place; NAV-04 Breadcrumb path bar
what_it_is: Click a previewed shape to select, reveal and frame the node that made it on the canvas, even inside sub-flows.

name: Slider settings: whole, even, odd, step, limits and units
depends_on: values (slider); expressions; property editor
what_it_is: Number kind (decimal, whole, even, odd), step, soft and hard limits, drawing units and precision, and ranges driven by other inputs on the slider.

name: Save a selection to the library as a snippet
source_programs: Grasshopper 1 (User Objects); ComfyUI (Subgraph Blueprints); Node-RED; TouchDesigner; Nuke; Dynamo 3.x; Modo
depends_on: sub-flows; library folder (.urbflow); LIB-06 Item details
what_it_is: One command collapses the selected nodes, asks for name, category and description, and saves them to the library ready for search.

name: Team library locations, including a shared drive
source_programs: Blender 4.x; Dynamo 3.x; Grasshopper 1; n8n; Dynamo Player
depends_on: library folder; import as a link; LIB-04 Library panel
what_it_is: Several library folders (personal plus read-only office folders on a shared drive) listed in settings and searched together.

name: Wire and data-shape legend with concept cards
depends_on: typed wires with strokes, STATE-02 warnings that explain
what_it_is: A legend and short concept cards explain wire colours and strokes and how items, lists and lists of lists combine.

name: Empty-canvas hints and next-step suggestions
depends_on: Recording, sources (selection, layer, spreadsheet range), search filtered to compatible nodes
what_it_is: An empty flow offers a few big starting actions (selection, layer, Record commands, example) and next-step chips at loose outputs.

name: Per-node run time on the canvas
depends_on: Run modes (long-run hint); groups; output port count badges
what_it_is: Each node shows how long it took on the last run, with group and flow totals, so users can find the slow step.

name: Quick-add with initial values and ranges
depends_on: PORT-01; PORT-05
what_it_is: Search syntax that picks a node and sets values at once, such as 2..10 for a slider or Offset 5 m.

name: Insert from search into a selected wire
depends_on: selectable wires; FIND-12
what_it_is: Select a wire, press Tab and the chosen node is spliced into it, without dragging.

name: Filter search by data type or category
depends_on: typed port declarations; PORT-05
what_it_is: Chips or prefixes that narrow search by input type, output type, category or source.

name: Move, copy and swap wires with modifier drags
source_programs: Grasshopper 1; Unreal Blueprints; Blender 4.x; Dynamo 3.x; Nuke; Node-RED
depends_on: WIRE-10
what_it_is: Modifier drags from a port move one wire, move all of a port's wires or add a wire without replacing.

name: Wire styles, fading and faint wires
depends_on: WIRE-04
what_it_is: Per-flow curved, straight or orthogonal wires, fading of long wires and per-wire faint display.

name: Reset to default and show changed values
depends_on: PORT-01
what_it_is: Values that differ from the default are marked and one action restores the default.

name: Hide unused and advanced ports
depends_on: PORT-08
what_it_is: Rarely used inputs sit behind a More row and unconnected ports can be hidden in one keystroke.

name: Author-defined check node (custom warnings)
depends_on: expressions; STATE-01; STATE-06; flow as a tool
what_it_is: A Check node raises an author-written info, warning or error message when a condition holds, so flows used as tools guard their inputs for non-authors.

name: Copy and export a port's data
group: Data shapes (lists, trees, paths, matching rules, graft and flatten, data viewers, spreadsheet-like views)
depends_on: DATA-02 Viewer node; DATA-05 Spreadsheet view
what_it_is: Copy any port as a table to the clipboard or export it to CSV from the peek, viewer or spreadsheet view.

name: Bypass or disable a whole group
depends_on: CONT-12 Group membership by enclosure; D disable; B bypass
what_it_is: Apply disable or bypass to every node in a group in one step and show that state on the group header.

name: Follow a wire to its other end
depends_on: arrows between nodes; fit
what_it_is: Hover a wire to see where it comes from and goes to, and jump the view to its other end.

name: Align and distribute selected nodes
source_programs: Houdini; Node-RED; Blender 4.x/5.x (Node Arrange extension); Grasshopper 1 (SnappingGecko)
depends_on: tidy; rectangle selection
what_it_is: Line up selected nodes on an edge or centre, space them evenly, or tidy only the selection or one branch.

name: Canvas bookmarks and quick views
source_programs: Houdini; Unreal Blueprints; Nuke; Substance 3D Designer; TouchDesigner
depends_on: groups; fit; per-tab canvas state
what_it_is: Save places on the canvas (position, zoom, sub-flow) and jump back to them by key or from a list, with group titles as automatic bookmarks.

name: Preview colour per node or group
group: Previews in the drawing and inspection
depends_on: flow's own layer; groups with colour
what_it_is: Give a node or group its own preview colour, optionally the group's canvas colour, so design options read apart in the drawing.

name: Comments attached to nodes
depends_on: property editor (Enter), sticky notes
what_it_is: A short comment stored on one node, shown as a badge or bubble, that moves, copies and travels with the node.

name: Flow info card: description, author, version, thumbnail
depends_on: library folder (.urbflow), flow tools on the rail and in search
what_it_is: Each flow carries a title, description, author, version, thumbnail and required Studio version, shown in the library and on hover.

name: Keyboard shortcut reference overlay
depends_on: keyboard shortcuts, accessible names
what_it_is: A searchable overlay (Shift+?) listing every canvas shortcut, generated from the same table that defines them.

name: Runaway-run guard
depends_on: Output port count badges; Run modes; a cost hint per command
what_it_is: Before a heavy node runs, check the incoming item count and ask first when it would create millions of items.

name: Freeze a drawing source into a stored snapshot
source_programs: Grasshopper 1 (internalised data); Dynamo for Civil 3D (binding stored in graph or in drawing)
depends_on: Sources (pasted shapes); flows save to a library folder (.urbflow)
what_it_is: Turn a live layer or selection source into shapes stored inside the flow file, and re-link it to the drawing later.

name: Re-run when an input file changes (file watcher)
source_programs: Node-RED (watch node); n8n (Local File Trigger); Grasshopper 1 (file watching on Read File / File Path); Dynamo for Civil 3D (Excel-driven graph in Automatic mode); Grasshopper 1 (TT Toolbox)
depends_on: Sources (a spreadsheet range); changed-on-disk states and reload; Run modes
what_it_is: When a spreadsheet or other file a flow reads is saved by someone else, the source is marked changed and the flow re-runs (automatic mode) or offers Reload.

name: Browsable node library panel
source_programs: Dynamo 3.x; ComfyUI; Unreal Material Editor; Node-RED; TouchDesigner
depends_on: search index (name, keywords, tags); FIND-04; Flow library folder
what_it_is: A dockable panel listing every node by category with a filter, hover details and drag-to-canvas, for browsing instead of guessing names.

name: Search results that show what a node does
depends_on: a description per command; PORT-02
what_it_is: Each search or library result shows a plain description, inputs and outputs with types and a small preview before placing.

name: Edit default values right on the node
source_programs: Blender 4.x; Unity Shader Graph; ComfyUI; Houdini; Enso
depends_on: PORT-05; PORT-08
what_it_is: Each unconnected input shows a compact editable field on the node (number, text, choice, toggle, colour, layer).

name: Error and warning states on nodes
source_programs: Grasshopper 1; Dynamo 3.x; Houdini; Blender 4.x; Sverchok; ComfyUI
depends_on: commands that report failures as data; accessible names; test bridge
what_it_is: Every node shows the outcome of its last run (normal, info, warning, error) with a state strip and icon, worst state winning, readable when zoomed out.

name: Plain-language message with a suggested fix
depends_on: STATE-01 Error and warning states on nodes; Show and Select pills; LEARN help pages
what_it_is: The node's message says what failed in drawing terms (which items, which input) and offers one-click actions such as selecting the failed shapes or showing the upstream node.

name: "Why is this empty?" upstream trace
depends_on: Explain this number; count badges; STATE-02 Plain-language message with a suggested fix
what_it_is: From a port showing 0 items or empty values, Explain walks upstream to the first node where the count dropped and shows what that node received.

name: Matching rule per node, shown on the node
group: Data shapes (lists, trees, paths, matching rules, graft and flatten, data viewers, spreadsheet-like views)
depends_on: wire strokes; count badges; STATE-01
what_it_is: A visible chip on multi-input nodes states how lists of different lengths pair (1:1, repeat last, cycle, all x all) and warns with counts when lengths differ.

name: Find in flow (Ctrl+F) by name, value or warning
source_programs: Blender 4.x/5.x; Houdini; Unreal Blueprints; Node-RED; Grasshopper 1
depends_on: fuzzy search (Tab search); fit; NAV-04 for sub-flow paths
what_it_is: Find nodes already on the canvas by name, title, note text, port value or warning, and step through the matches with the view framing each.

name: Player: run a library flow from a simple form
source_programs: Dynamo Player (Revit, Forma); ComfyUI App Mode; n8n Form Trigger; Grasshopper 1 (Human UI)
depends_on: PARAM-03 Expose any value as a tool input; LIB-06 Item details; Bake; run modes
what_it_is: A pane that lists library flows as cards and runs one from a form of its exposed inputs, with preview and apply, without opening the canvas.

name: Run-time prompts for picks and values
depends_on: PARAM-03 Expose any value as a tool input; flow-as-tool (PARAM-14)
what_it_is: A flow-tool asks for its inputs like a CAD command: pick shapes with type filters and type values at the command line, with defaults, Enter and Undo.

name: Expose any value as a tool input, with label, tooltip and default
source_programs: Blender 4.x; Unreal Blueprints; Unity Shader Graph; Nuke; Archicad PARAM-O; Marionette (Vectorworks)
depends_on: values (number, slider, text, choice, bool); sub-flows with exposed ports; flow-as-tool (PARAM-14)
what_it_is: Any value or source node, not only a slider, can be exposed as a tool input with label, tooltip, default, unit and order in one inputs list.

name: Template gallery on New
source_programs: ComfyUI; n8n; Dynamo 3.x; Node-RED; Rhino 8 Script component
depends_on: LIB-06 Item details; sticky notes; library folder (.urbflow)
what_it_is: A New dialog with starter flows as picture cards that open as a working copy with sample inputs and an explaining note.

name: Missing-item report and placeholders on open
depends_on: linked flows (missing state), sources, flow tools with their own command id
what_it_is: When anything a flow needs is absent at open, keep placeholder nodes with their wires and list every missing item with a fix, instead of failing or dropping nodes.

name: Node help panel (F1)
depends_on: commands declare their inputs, accessible names, property editor
what_it_is: A docked panel, opened with F1, that explains the selected node in plain language with its inputs, outputs, notes and a manual link.

name: Managed bake that replaces its previous output
source_programs: Rhino 8 Grasshopper (Content Cache); Elefront (Grasshopper plugin); Dynamo for Civil 3D (object binding); Rhino.Inside.Revit (Element Tracking)
depends_on: Bake copies results to a layer; Made-by badge; apply as one undo step
what_it_is: Bake remembers the drawing objects it made and, on the next bake, replaces or updates them instead of adding duplicate copies.

name: Ranked "suggest next node"
depends_on: Flow library folder (.urbflow) for local statistics; FIND-04
what_it_is: From any port, a short list of the most likely next nodes ranked by local usage counts, with a ghost preview.

name: Visible automatic conversion on type mismatch
source_programs: Unreal Blueprints; Blender 4.x; Unity Shader Graph
depends_on: WIRE-02; PORT-05
what_it_is: Convertible types joined by a wire get a visible conversion chip that can be read or expanded, never a silent lossy conversion.

name: Units on ports
depends_on: PORT-01; WIRE-02; WIRE-03
what_it_is: Ports declare a quantity such as length, area or angle and show and accept values in the drawing's units.

name: Problems panel with counts and locate
depends_on: STATE-01; STATE-02; fit (F, Home, A); sub-flows
what_it_is: A chip ('2 errors, 5 warnings') that cycles and frames each problem node, plus a docked list of all messages including those inside sub-flows and linked flows.

name: Per-node error policy: stop, skip failed items, error output
depends_on: STATE-01; wire strokes for lists; Show and Select pills
what_it_is: List commands skip failed items with a warning by default and can expose a 'failed' output port with the failed inputs and reasons; stop is the other choice.

name: Spreadsheet view of a port
group: Data shapes (lists, trees, paths, matching rules, graft and flatten, data viewers, spreadsheet-like views)
depends_on: DATA-02 Viewer node; attribute key sources; count badges
what_it_is: A docked table of the selected port: rows are items, columns are index, path, type, key measures and attribute keys, with sort, filter, search and row counts.

name: Graft, flatten, simplify and reverse on ports
group: Data shapes (lists, trees, paths, matching rules, graft and flatten, data viewers, spreadsheet-like views)
depends_on: wire strokes; hover peek; DATA-01 Matching rule
what_it_is: Port modifiers with plain names (each item separately, all in one list, remove extra levels, reverse) that reshape data in place and update the wire stroke.

name: Viewer rows linked to the drawing
group: Data shapes (lists, trees, paths, matching rules, graft and flatten, data viewers, spreadsheet-like views)
depends_on: DATA-02 or DATA-05; Show and Select pills; Made-by badge
what_it_is: Hovering or selecting rows in a viewer or table highlights or selects the shapes in the drawing, and selecting shapes filters the rows.

name: Open a sub-flow in place (enter, edit, go back up)
source_programs: Blender 4.x/5.x; Houdini; TouchDesigner; Dynamo 2.x/3.x; ComfyUI; Nuke; Unreal Blueprints
depends_on: NAV-04 Breadcrumb path bar; canvas history; per-tab canvas state
what_it_is: Step inside a sub-flow to see and edit its nodes without expanding it, then return to the parent flow.

name: Collapse a group to its title bar
depends_on: CONT-12 Group membership by enclosure; output port count badges
what_it_is: Fold a whole group into one header bar that keeps its title, node count and the wires that leave it.

name: For-each by key (one pass per attribute value)
depends_on: for-each container; attribute key source; lineage
what_it_is: Run the for-each once per distinct value of a key (district, land use, block id), handing each pass the whole set of shapes with that value.

name: Sub-flow interface editor (port names, order, defaults, ranges, tooltips, sections)
source_programs: Blender 4.x/5.x; Dynamo 2.x/3.x; n8n; ComfyUI; Unity VFX Graph; Cables.gl
depends_on: sub-flows; property editor; value nodes (slider ranges)
what_it_is: A panel where the author names, orders, documents and sets defaults and ranges for a sub-flow's exposed ports, grouped in collapsible sections.

name: Shared sub-flow definition (edit once, every copy updates)
source_programs: Houdini; Max/MSP; Node-RED; Blender 4.x/5.x; Dynamo 2.x/3.x; Cables.gl
depends_on: CONT-04 Open a sub-flow in place; canvas history; import as a link
what_it_is: Copies of a sub-flow inside a flow share one definition, show how many copies exist, and all change when one is edited.

name: Outline panel of groups, notes, sub-flows and nodes
depends_on: groups; sticky notes; accessible names; NAV-01 Find in flow
what_it_is: A side panel that lists the flow as a tree of groups, sub-flows, notes and nodes, filterable, where a click frames the item.

name: Isolate one node or port (viewer) with the rest ghosted
group: Previews in the drawing and inspection
depends_on: PREV-03 Per-node preview; PREV-04 Highlight; flow's own layer
what_it_is: Show only one node's or one port's shapes in the drawing, with the flow's other results drawn faint for context.

name: Colour by value with a legend (thematic preview)
group: Previews in the drawing and inspection
source_programs: Houdini; Dynamo 2.x/3.x; Grasshopper 1; Grasshopper 1 (Ladybug); Grasshopper 2 beta
depends_on: flow's own layer; attribute key; Bake
what_it_is: Colour a port's shapes by a number or category (ramp or palette, class breaks) and show a legend in the drawing.

name: Value labels in the drawing (measurement overlays)
group: Previews in the drawing and inspection
depends_on: flow's own layer; Explain this number; Bake
what_it_is: Show a port's values (area, GFA, coverage) as preview-only text on each shape in the drawing.

name: Flow inputs panel
source_programs: Grasshopper 1 (Remote Control Panel); Blender 4.x; ComfyUI; Houdini
depends_on: PARAM-03 Expose any value as a tool input; floating or docked window
what_it_is: One dockable panel listing every exposed input of the open flow, editable without finding the nodes on the canvas.

name: Named presets of input values
source_programs: Houdini; Grasshopper 1; Rhino 8 Grasshopper Player; Dynamo
depends_on: PARAM-03 Expose any value as a tool input; PARAM-05 Flow inputs panel; canvas history
what_it_is: Save a named set of input values in the flow and restore it in one click from the panel, tool or Player.

name: Library panel with thumbnails and drag to canvas
source_programs: Blender 4.x (Asset Browser); TouchDesigner (Palette); ComfyUI (node library); Dynamo Player
depends_on: library folder; import as a copy or a link; LIB-06 Item details; flow-as-tool (PARAM-14)
what_it_is: A dockable panel showing library items as pictures, with hover cards, drag onto the canvas as a node or into the drawing to run as a tool.

name: Bundled starter library (Essentials)
depends_on: LIB-03 Team library locations; LIB-06 Item details; sub-flows with exposed ports
what_it_is: A read-only library of tested urban sub-flows shipped with the program, inserted as links and updated with releases.

name: Pack a flow with everything it needs
depends_on: library folder (.urbflow), import as a copy or a link, COLLAB-01 missing-item report
what_it_is: Write one file that carries the flow plus its linked flows and flow tools, with a checklist of drawing-side needs, so it opens anywhere.

name: Version history with restore
depends_on: library folder (.urbflow), canvas history separate from drawing history, COLLAB-09 flow info (author, name)
what_it_is: Keep earlier saves of each flow that can be listed, previewed, restored or opened as a copy, with no server or git needed.

name: Copy and paste nodes as text, between flows and apps
depends_on: .urbflow format, import as a copy, COLLAB-01 missing-item report
what_it_is: Copy a selection as readable text that pastes into another flow, an email, a forum post or an AI chat, and back.

name: Example flow for each node
source_programs: Houdini; Dynamo; Node-RED; ComfyUI; Grasshopper 2 beta
depends_on: LEARN-01 help panel, import as a copy, groups with title, run modes
what_it_is: Each node's help offers small example flows to open read-only or insert as a titled group with manual run.

name: Start page with samples and learning links
depends_on: library folder (.urbflow), templates (LIB group), COLLAB-09 flow info (thumbnail), LEARN-09 guided tours
what_it_is: With no flow open, show recent flows, starter samples, tours and office-chosen learning links.

name: Progress and "running now" on each node
depends_on: Cancel; loop pass count and for-each item count; Background solving (PERF-06)
what_it_is: During a run the computing node is outlined, long nodes fill a progress bar and the flow shows how many nodes are done.

name: Run up to this node
depends_on: Run modes; an out-of-date node state (STATE group)
what_it_is: Run only the selected node and the upstream nodes it needs, leaving the rest of the flow untouched.

name: Re-run only what changed (result cache)
depends_on: Live values dependency graph; drawing change notices for sources (CAD group)
what_it_is: Every node keeps its last output so an edit re-runs only the nodes downstream of it, with reused nodes marked.

name: Freeze or pin a node's output
depends_on: Re-run only what changed (PERF-04); saving results and lineage in .urbflow
what_it_is: Stop a slow node computing while it keeps feeding its last result downstream, optionally saved in the flow file.

name: Expressions typed into any input
source_programs: Blender 4.x; Houdini; TouchDesigner; Nuke; n8n; Grasshopper 1; Natron; Antimony
depends_on: Expression editor (SCRIPT-03); property editor; Live values
what_it_is: Any number or text field on a node accepts a formula, evaluated once or kept live, with an fx badge on the port.

name: Expression editor with live preview and plain errors
depends_on: Expression node (SCRIPT-13); output port hover peek
what_it_is: Formula editing with input-name chips, a function list, a live result on the first items and errors in plain words.

name: Per-item attribute formula (wrangle-style)
depends_on: Expressions typed into any input (SCRIPT-02); expression editor (SCRIPT-03); attribute writing (CAD group)
what_it_is: A node that runs short formulas once per parcel or building, reading and writing attributes by name.

name: AI explains a flow, a node or an error
depends_on: Agent API (SCRIPT-06); model connection from SCRIPT-01; node error states (STATE group)
what_it_is: Ask what a flow does or why a node fails and get a plain answer linked to the nodes, built on lineage.

name: Query drawing objects by rule
source_programs: Rhino 8 Grasshopper (Query Model Objects); Rhino.Inside.Revit (Query Elements with filters); Dynamo for Revit (All Elements of Category / Family Type); Elefront (reference by attribute)
depends_on: Sources (a layer, an attribute key); Live link per drawing object (CAD-05)
what_it_is: One source node that gathers drawing objects by combined rules (layer with sublayers, type, name, attribute key and value, block), picked from lists rather than typed.

name: Bake with attributes (layer, colour, name, attribute values)
source_programs: Rhino 8 Grasshopper (Model Object, bake with custom attributes); Elefront (Bake Objects with attributes); Grasshopper 2 beta
depends_on: Bake copies results to a layer; Managed bake (CAD-01)
what_it_is: Bake sets each result's layer, colour, line style, name and attribute key-values from flow data, creating missing layers.

name: Write attributes onto existing drawing objects
source_programs: Rhino 8 Grasshopper (User Text component, Content Cache update); Dynamo for Revit (Element.SetParameterByName); Grasshopper 1 (Elefront)
depends_on: Sources; an attribute key; Live values; preview and one undo step
what_it_is: A node that sets, merges or deletes attribute keys (and name, layer, colour) on objects already in the drawing without re-creating them.

name: Live link per drawing object, with missing-object state
source_programs: Grasshopper 1 (referenced geometry); Dynamo for Revit (Select Model Element); Houdini Engine for Unreal (World Input, Update Automatically)
depends_on: Sources; Run modes: automatic; Live values dependency graph; linked-flow missing states as a pattern
what_it_is: Sources track the exact drawing objects they read, re-run when one is edited, and show a clear missing state when one is deleted.

name: Block definitions and instances
source_programs: Rhino 8 Grasshopper (block definitions and instances); Dynamo for Civil 3D (Block References); Houdini Engine for Unreal (instancers, foliage)
depends_on: Managed bake (CAD-01); Bake with attributes (CAD-03)
what_it_is: Read block instances as data (name, placement, attributes) and place or update block instances such as trees, street furniture and standard building types from a flow.

name: Data-driven labels and annotation
source_programs: Rhino 8 Grasshopper (annotation styles, text and hatches)
depends_on: Nodes are the program's own commands; Live values; Units and site coordinates (CAD-08); Managed bake (CAD-01)
what_it_is: Labels, tags, dimensions and hatches whose text and style come from flow data (for example plot name and GFA) and update on every run.

name: Units and site coordinates
source_programs: Dynamo (Convert Between Units, Geometry Working Range); Archicad PARAM-O (Length node follows working units); Grasshopper 1 (Wombat)
depends_on: Values (number, slider); count badges and hover peek; Explain this number
what_it_is: Values show and convert the drawing's units (m, m2, ha, %), and flows can work around a site origin when the drawing uses georeferenced coordinates far from zero.

name: Option sweep with a results table
source_programs: Houdini PDG (Wedge TOP); Revit Generative Design with Dynamo (Randomize, Cross-product); Colibri (Grasshopper, Design Explorer data sets)
depends_on: Exposed sliders; loop container (pass count, time limit); long-run mode recommendation; Write results to a spreadsheet (AUTO-02)
what_it_is: Run a flow over ranges, lists or random values of its exposed sliders, record chosen result numbers and a picture per option, and browse, sort and restore options in a table.

name: Write results to a spreadsheet or report on each run
source_programs: Houdini PDG (CSV Output TOP); n8n (Convert to File: CSV, XLSX); Colibri (Grasshopper data sets)
depends_on: Sources (a spreadsheet range); lineage; Run on drawing events (AUTO-05)
what_it_is: An output node that writes a table of results (rows per item, columns per attribute) to a named range or sheet in .xlsx or .csv, refreshing the same place each run.

name: Hotkeys for frequent nodes
source_programs: Unreal Blueprints; Unreal Material Editor; Nuke; Max/MSP; ComfyUI; Grasshopper 1
depends_on: FIND-03
what_it_is: Hold a key and click to drop a frequent node without opening search, with user-assignable bindings.

name: Connect many nodes at once
depends_on: WIRE-02 compatibility matching
what_it_is: One gesture wires several selected nodes together or one output to several inputs.

name: Profile report (slowest nodes list)
depends_on: Per-node run time (PERF-01); fit; test bridge
what_it_is: A panel that records a run and lists nodes sorted by time with counts and share of total, click to select.

name: Hold gate (data dam)
depends_on: Run modes; Freeze or pin (PERF-05)
what_it_is: A node that holds the last data and passes new data only after a pause, a click or a true value, for one branch.

name: Batch error handling: skip, retry and failure log
source_programs: n8n (On Error, Retry On Fail, error workflows); Houdini PDG (Local Scheduler On Task Failure); Revit Batch Processor (third party)
depends_on: for-each container; Batch run (AUTO-04); Option sweep (AUTO-01)
what_it_is: For long batches and sweeps, choose stop, skip and continue, or retry on an error, and get a list of the items that failed with their inputs and messages.

name: Reroute points
source_programs: Blender 4.x; Houdini; Unreal Material Editor; Unity Shader Graph; ComfyUI; Nuke; Modo
depends_on: tidy (layered layout) must respect points
what_it_is: Points placed on a wire by double-click that bend it around nodes and can branch it.

name: Several wires into one input, in a visible order
depends_on: WIRE-08; list strokes on wires
what_it_is: List-taking inputs accept several wires and show and let the user change the merge order.

name: Named wireless links
source_programs: Unreal Material Editor; Max/MSP; Grasshopper 1 (Telepathy); Cables.gl; Grasshopper 2 beta
depends_on: WIRE-04; lineage
what_it_is: A named sender and receivers carry data without a drawn wire, with both ends labelled and a ghost wire on hover.

name: Add and remove inputs on the node
depends_on: WIRE-10
what_it_is: Nodes that take a variable number of inputs show a visible add-input row and an auto-growing slot.

name: Context defaults for empty inputs
depends_on: PORT-01; lineage
what_it_is: An unconnected input takes a declared context value such as the current selection or the flow's layer, and says so.

name: Run trace on the canvas
depends_on: STATE-01; run modes; cancel
what_it_is: During and after a run, nodes show ran / skipped / failed / not reached, the running node pulses and wires that carried data brighten briefly.

name: Structure viewer for nested lists
group: Data shapes (lists, trees, paths, matching rules, graft and flatten, data viewers, spreadsheet-like views)
depends_on: count badges; hover peek; DATA-02 Viewer node
what_it_is: A 'Shape' line and collapsible outline show how many sublists, items per sublist and empty sublists a list of lists holds.

name: Pick items from a list visually
group: Data shapes (lists, trees, paths, matching rules, graft and flatten, data viewers, spreadsheet-like views)
depends_on: lineage; DATA-07 Viewer rows linked to the drawing; Made-by badge
what_it_is: A Pick node with a searchable checklist and a pick-in-drawing mode stores chosen items of a computed list by a stable key and warns when they disappear.

name: Group membership by enclosure, auto-fit and nesting
source_programs: Blender 4.x/5.x; Houdini; Nuke; Unreal Blueprints; Dynamo 2.x/3.x
depends_on: groups; one-step group move
what_it_is: A node belongs to the group whose box it sits in, the box grows to fit dropped nodes, and groups can sit inside groups.

name: Inspect one pass of a loop or for-each
depends_on: loop and for-each containers; hover peek; PREV-05 Isolate one node or port
what_it_is: Pick one iteration of a container and see that pass's inner values and shapes, or run only that pass while editing.

name: Promote a sub-flow to a library tool
source_programs: Houdini; ComfyUI; Unreal Blueprints; Dynamo 2.x/3.x; n8n; Natron; GenerativeComponents
depends_on: CONT-07 Sub-flow interface editor; library folder; import as a link; flow as a tool
what_it_is: Turn a sub-flow built inside one flow into a library tool and replace the local copy with a linked instance.

name: Zoom-dependent detail (semantic zoom)
source_programs: Grasshopper 1; Dynamo 2.x/3.x; ComfyUI; Unreal Blueprints; Grasshopper 1 (Sunglasses)
depends_on: groups; node states (errors, disabled, bypassed)
what_it_is: Show different detail at different zoom: big group titles and error dots when far, extra inline controls when close.

name: Thumbnails of results on the node
group: Previews in the drawing and inspection
source_programs: Unity Shader Graph; Unreal Material Editor; Substance 3D Designer; TouchDesigner
depends_on: hover peek; PREV-03 Per-node preview
what_it_is: An optional small plan picture of a node's shapes drawn on the node itself.

name: Form layout: sections, order and conditional hide or disable
source_programs: Houdini; Blender 4.x; Nuke; TouchDesigner; Unity Shader Graph; Dynamo Player
depends_on: PARAM-03 Expose any value as a tool input; PARAM-05 Flow inputs panel
what_it_is: Folding sections, explicit order, separators and notes in the input list, plus show-when and enable-when rules set from a picker.

name: Menu switch: a choice that picks the branch
depends_on: values (choice); run engine able to skip branches; PARAM-09 Form layout for hiding
what_it_is: A Switch node driven by a choice value: only the chosen branch runs, and the option names show as a dropdown on the tool.

name: Table and list inputs
depends_on: values; list and list-of-lists wires; PARAM-03 Expose any value as a tool input
what_it_is: An editable table value node with typed columns and add/remove rows (unit mix, land-use shares), output as a list or list of lists.

name: Curve (ramp) input
depends_on: values; expressions; PARAM-05 Flow inputs panel
what_it_is: A small graph with draggable points that maps an input to an output, for gradients such as height falling off with distance.

name: Item details: thumbnail, description, author and icon
source_programs: Blender 4.x; Houdini; Node-RED; ComfyUI; Dynamo Player
depends_on: library folder (.urbflow); results show in the drawing on the flow's own layer
what_it_is: Each library flow stores a thumbnail captured from its result, description, author, dates, tags and icon, shown as a card.

name: Categories, tags and search across the library
depends_on: search at the cursor; LIB-04 Library panel; LIB-06 Item details
what_it_is: A catalog tree and tags for library items, with Tab search covering every library flow and snippet, not only published tools.

name: Diffable, stable text file format
depends_on: .urbflow format
what_it_is: Guarantee .urbflow is deterministic UTF-8 text with layout kept apart from logic, so diffs and version control show real changes.

name: Upgrade outdated nodes when opening an older flow
source_programs: Grasshopper 1; Dynamo; Houdini; ComfyUI; Cables.gl; Grasshopper 2 beta
depends_on: commands declare their inputs, COLLAB-01 missing-item report, COLLAB-09 flow info (Studio version)
what_it_is: Mark nodes whose command changed since the flow was saved and upgrade them keeping wires and values, with a backup.

name: Autosave and recovery after a crash or hang
depends_on: canvas history separate from drawing history; .urbflow files; cancel (Esc); PERF-06 Background solving
what_it_is: Save a recovery copy of every open flow on a timer and when the program hangs, and offer to restore it at the next start.

name: Guided tours
depends_on: accessible names on every control, test bridge, Recording, Explain this number
what_it_is: Short interactive walkthroughs that highlight one control at a time and wait for the user to do each step.

name: Help for your own flow tools
depends_on: flow tools with their own command id, expressions, LEARN-01 help panel, PORT-02 tooltips
what_it_is: Authors of flow tools write a description, per-port help, examples and input warnings that users see in tooltips, help and search.

name: Replay how a flow was built (build steps)
depends_on: canvas history; groups with title; PERF-03 Run up to this node; tidy (layered layout)
what_it_is: Named stages recorded while a flow is built, which a reader plays forward and back to see nodes and drawing results appear in the order the author made them.

name: Cache to disk node
depends_on: Freeze or pin (PERF-05) saving format; lineage; library folder (.urbflow)
what_it_is: A node that stores the upstream result in a file and reads it back instead of recomputing until refreshed.

name: Skip branches nobody uses (lazy evaluation)
depends_on: Re-run only what changed (PERF-04); Show and Select pills; Bake
what_it_is: Compute only the outputs that something shown, baked or exposed needs, and only the chosen branch of a switch.

name: Agent API (MCP) to build and run flows
depends_on: Test bridge; canvas history; a permission prompt
what_it_is: A documented tool interface (MCP) so AI agents and scripts can add and wire nodes, set values, run and read results.

name: AI writes an expression or a script
depends_on: AI assistant (SCRIPT-01) model connection; expression editor (SCRIPT-03); Python script node (SCRIPT-07)
what_it_is: Describe the intent in an expression or script node and get proposed code with a preview, applied only on a click.

name: Batch run over many drawings
source_programs: Houdini PDG (File Pattern TOP); Revit Batch Processor (Dynamo, third party); Rhino (start-up /runscript with -GrasshopperPlayer)
depends_on: Flow as a command (command id); Batch error handling (AUTO-07); flow library
what_it_is: Pick a folder or list of drawings and run one flow on each (open, run, apply, save or export), with a log of what happened.

name: Run on drawing events (open, before save, before export)
source_programs: Blender 4.x/5.x (bpy.app.handlers load_post, save_pre); Houdini (456.py, beforescenesave.py); Rhino (start-up /runscript)
depends_on: Flow as a command; apply as one undo step
what_it_is: Mark a flow to run when the drawing opens, before it is saved or before export, for example to refresh an area schedule.

name: AI assistant that builds or edits a flow from a prompt
depends_on: Agent API (SCRIPT-06); search names, keywords and tags; canvas history
what_it_is: A chat panel where the user describes a result and the assistant adds, wires and sets nodes, shown as a preview to accept.

name: Handles in the drawing bound to inputs (gizmos)
depends_on: PARAM-03 Expose any value as a tool input; results show in the drawing on the flow's own layer; run modes
what_it_is: Drag an arrow, dial or move handle in the drawing to change an exposed number, with handle and value kept in step both ways.

name: Option exploration and comparison
source_programs: Dynamo Generative Design (Revit); Houdini (PDG Wedge); Design Explorer (CORE studio); Speckle Design Explorer
depends_on: PARAM-03 Expose any value as a tool input; PARAM-06 Named presets; lineage and Explain this number; Bake; cancel
what_it_is: Run a flow over many input combinations, record metrics, and compare options in a thumbnail grid, sortable table and parallel-coordinates chart, then use one.

name: Background solving with a responsive canvas
depends_on: Cancel; commands that separate computing from applying to the drawing; one undo step per run
what_it_is: Runs compute off the interface thread so the canvas and Esc stay responsive and a new edit cancels a stale run.

name: Flow-driven parametric object in the drawing
source_programs: Vectorworks Marionette (Marionette objects); Archicad PARAM-O (library parts); Houdini Engine for Unreal (Houdini Asset Actors); VisualARQ for Rhino (Grasshopper Styles)
depends_on: Flow as a tool with its own command id; exposed sliders; Managed bake (CAD-01); Live link per drawing object (CAD-05)
what_it_is: Place a flow as a drawing object whose own parameter values are edited in the property editor and which re-runs when they or its control shapes change.

name: Work on sublists per input (list levels)
group: Data shapes (lists, trees, paths, matching rules, graft and flatten, data viewers, spreadsheet-like views)
depends_on: for-each container; wire strokes; DATA-01 Matching rule
what_it_is: A per-input choice 'whole list / each sublist' so a node works on each sublist without wrapping it in a for-each container.

name: Search across sub-flows and the library (where used)
depends_on: NAV-01 Find in flow; library folder; linked flows
what_it_is: Widen Find to every sub-flow and every flow in the library folder, and list where a tool is used.

name: Split view of one flow
depends_on: per-tab canvas state; CONT-04 Open a sub-flow in place
what_it_is: Show two canvases of the same flow side by side, for example the parent and the inside of a sub-flow.

name: Versioned library items
depends_on: import as a link; LIB-03 Team library locations; LIB-06 Item details
what_it_is: Library flows carry a version; links stay pinned to theirs and offer an update with a summary of changed inputs.

name: Package installs for script nodes
depends_on: Python script node (SCRIPT-07); flows saved to a library folder (.urbflow); linked flows
what_it_is: A script node declares the libraries it needs in one line and the program installs pinned versions for it.

name: Publish a script as a command
depends_on: Python script node (SCRIPT-07); package installs (SCRIPT-10); library folder
what_it_is: Turn a flow containing script nodes into a named command and node with icon and help that colleagues use without code.

name: Command-line and headless runs
source_programs: Dynamo (DynamoCLI); Houdini (hython); Blender (--background --python); n8n (n8n execute); Rhino (-GrasshopperPlayer, Rhino.Compute); Natron
depends_on: Test bridge drives everything by data; flow command ids
what_it_is: Run a saved flow on a drawing from the command line with input values and output files, without opening the user interface.

name: Run history
source_programs: n8n (Executions list); ComfyUI (Job History, /history API); Houdini PDG (work item results)
depends_on: Run modes; exposed sliders; canvas history
what_it_is: A list of past runs with time, trigger, duration, status and changed inputs, from which a past run's input values can be restored.

name: Scheduled runs
source_programs: n8n (Schedule Trigger); Node-RED (Inject node, cron); Dynamo (Periodic run mode); Revit Batch Processor (Windows Task Scheduler)
depends_on: Command-line and headless runs (AUTO-06)
what_it_is: Run a flow on a drawing at set times, for example a nightly refresh of a shared area schedule, by registering a Windows scheduled task that calls the command line.

name: Visual diff between two versions of a flow
source_programs: Unreal Blueprints; n8n; Node-RED; Grasshopper 1 (third-party tool)
depends_on: COLLAB-05 version history, COLLAB-10 stable text format, tidy (layered layout)
what_it_is: Show two versions side by side with added, removed, changed and moved nodes coloured and a change list to step through.

name: Python script node
source_programs: Grasshopper 1 (Rhino 8); Dynamo 3.x; Houdini; Node-RED; n8n; Sverchok; Antimony
depends_on: An embedded Python runtime; typed wires; a trust prompt for shared flows
what_it_is: A node with a code editor where the user writes Python, declares inputs and outputs and gets results like any node.

name: Public SDK for third-party nodes
depends_on: Plug-in loading in the host program; versioning and packages (COLLAB group)
what_it_is: A documented interface so plug-in developers register a command once and it appears as a command and a Flow node.

name: Sheets, layouts and viewports from a flow
source_programs: Dynamo for Revit with Generative Design (views placed on sheets); Rhino 8 Grasshopper (layout access); Drafthorse (Grasshopper plugin for Rhino 8)
depends_on: Sources (a saved view); Managed bake (CAD-01); Data-driven labels (CAD-07)
what_it_is: Create and update sheets from a title block, place viewports of saved views at a scale, and fill title-block fields from flow data, for example one sheet per option.

name: Run history with per-node data
depends_on: count badges; STATE-02 messages; canvas history; .urbflow saving
what_it_is: Keep the last runs of a flow (input values, per-port counts, messages) to compare a port with the previous run or restore earlier inputs.

name: Breakpoints and step-through
source_programs: Unreal Blueprints; Node-RED; Rhino 8 Script component
depends_on: containers (loop with pass count); STATE-12 Run trace; cancel
what_it_is: Pause a run at a node or after each loop pass, inspect ports, then step, continue or cancel.

name: Packages of flow tools with versions and dependencies
source_programs: Dynamo; Rhino 8 / Grasshopper (Yak); Blender 4.x; ComfyUI; Node-RED
depends_on: library folder (.urbflow), flow tools with their own command id, COLLAB-09 flow info, COLLAB-11 upgrade outdated nodes
what_it_is: Publish, install, update and remove versioned bundles of flow tools from an office or community feed, flows only, no third-party code.

name: Share a flow to a web viewer
depends_on: a flow can expose a slider, Bake, COLLAB-09 flow info
what_it_is: Publish a flow's results and sliders to a browser page that people without Studio can open, starting with a static baked viewer.

name: Multithreaded nodes
depends_on: Background solving (PERF-06); thread-safe commands; for-each
what_it_is: Nodes split list work over several processor cores and independent branches run at the same time.

name: Flow to text and back (node to code, copy as script)
depends_on: Test bridge data format; Python script node (SCRIPT-07)
what_it_is: Copy selected nodes as readable text and paste text back as nodes, with node-to-code conversion later.

name: Search at the cursor
source_programs: Houdini; Nuke; Blender 4.x; Grasshopper 1; ComfyUI; Unity Shader Graph; TouchDesigner; Enso
what_it_is: Type-to-find box at the pointer that ranks nodes by name, keywords and synonyms and places the pick there.

name: Wire-drop search filtered to compatible nodes
source_programs: Blender 4.x; Unreal Blueprints; Unity Shader Graph; ComfyUI; Houdini
what_it_is: Dropping a wire on empty canvas opens search limited to nodes that fit that wire and wires the pick.

name: Typed values become source nodes
what_it_is: Typing a number or quoted text in search creates a value node instead of searching for a name.

name: Typed, coloured wires with structure strokes
source_programs: Blender 4.x; Max/MSP; Unity Shader Graph; ComfyUI
what_it_is: Wires and ports coloured by data type with strokes for one item, a list, a list of lists and lazy output.

name: Drop a node on a wire to splice it
what_it_is: Dropping a node onto a wire inserts it between the two ends.

name: Delete a node and reconnect around it
what_it_is: Deleting a node joins its upstream and downstream wires so the chain stays whole.

name: Cut wires with a stroke
what_it_is: A modifier-drag draws a line and every wire it crosses is cut.

name: Count badges and hover peek on outputs
what_it_is: Output ports show how many items they hold and a quick look at the first values.

name: Explain this number (lineage tree)
source_programs: n8n; Unreal Blueprints; Houdini; Grasshopper 1 (Traceback plugin)
what_it_is: From any figure, open a tree down to the shapes and the node that made them; the hub for messages and empty traces.

name: Disable and bypass
what_it_is: D disables a node and what depends on it; B passes its input through unchanged.

name: Groups with title and colour
source_programs: Blender 4.x/5.x; Houdini; Unreal Blueprints; Nuke; Node-RED; n8n; Dynamo 2.x/3.x; Substance 3D Designer
what_it_is: A titled, coloured box behind related nodes that labels a stage of the flow and moves its nodes together.

name: Collapse a selection into a sub-flow and expand it back
source_programs: Blender 4.x/5.x; Houdini; Unreal Blueprints; Nuke; Max/MSP; ComfyUI; Node-RED; Unity VFX Graph
what_it_is: Pack selected nodes into one node whose ports are the wires that crossed the selection edge, and unpack it again.

name: For-each container
what_it_is: A container that runs its inner nodes once per item (plot, block, building) and gathers the results.

name: Sticky notes
source_programs: Houdini; n8n; Unreal Blueprints; Dynamo 2.x/3.x; Substance 3D Designer
what_it_is: Free text blocks on the canvas that explain intent, inputs and caveats to the next reader.

name: Loop container with pass count, stop condition and limit
source_programs: Houdini; Blender 4.x/5.x; Unreal PCG; Grasshopper 1 (Anemone plug-in); Grasshopper 1 (Anemone)
what_it_is: A container that feeds each pass's output into the next until a count, stop expression or time limit is reached.

name: Pan, zoom and fit
source_programs: Houdini; Substance 3D Designer; ComfyUI; n8n; Dynamo 2.x/3.x
what_it_is: Pan and zoom the canvas and fit the view to everything or to the selection.

name: Tidy (automatic layered layout)
what_it_is: Automatically lay out nodes in layers so wires run left to right without overlaps.

name: Minimap
what_it_is: A small overview of the whole canvas with the visible area marked, clickable to jump.

name: Keyboard moves between connected nodes
what_it_is: Arrow keys move the selection to the next node up or down the chain without the mouse.

name: Live results in the drawing on the flow's own layer (Show and Select pills)
group: Previews in the drawing and inspection
what_it_is: Node results draw live in the CAD drawing on a layer owned by the flow, with pills to choose where results show and selection syncs.

name: Bake results to a layer
group: Previews in the drawing and inspection
what_it_is: Copy previewed results into real drawing objects on a chosen layer.

name: Made-by badge on hover
group: Previews in the drawing and inspection
what_it_is: Hovering a flow result in the drawing shows a badge naming the node that made it.

name: Value nodes: number, slider, text, choice, true/false
what_it_is: Typed constants set by hand: number, slider, text, choice and true/false.

name: A flow becomes a tool with an exposed slider
source_programs: Rhino 8 Grasshopper Player; Blender 4.x (node tools); Houdini (HDAs); Nuke (gizmos); Marionette (Vectorworks); Archicad PARAM-O
what_it_is: A saved flow with an exposed slider becomes a command with its own id, on the rail and in search, and a node in other flows.

name: Library folder of saved flows
what_it_is: Saved flows live as .urbflow files in a library folder for reuse in any drawing.

name: Import a flow as a copy or a link
what_it_is: A reused flow is either copied in or linked read-only to its file, with changed-on-disk and missing states, reload and unlink.

name: Linked-flow states: changed on disk, missing, reload, unlink
what_it_is: A linked flow shows when its file changed on disk or went missing, and offers Reload and Unlink.

name: Accessible names on every control
what_it_is: Every button, port, node and field has a name that screen readers and automation can read.

name: Run modes with a long-run hint
what_it_is: Automatic, manual and delayed recompute, with a suggestion to change mode after a slow run.

name: Cancel a running solution
what_it_is: Stop a run in progress with Esc without closing the program or changing the drawing.

name: Expression node
what_it_is: A node that evaluates a typed formula over its inputs.

name: Commands appear as nodes automatically
what_it_is: Every command of the host program is a node that runs from data, declares inputs, previews and undoes as one step.

name: Drawing sources: layer, selection, saved view, attribute key, spreadsheet range, pasted shapes
source_programs: Grasshopper 1 (referenced and internal data); Rhino 8 Grasshopper (Query Model Objects); Dynamo for Revit (Select Model Element); Dynamo in Forma (Player selection mode)
what_it_is: Source nodes that bring a layer, the selection, a saved view, an attribute key, a spreadsheet range or pasted shapes from the drawing into a flow.

name: Recording commands into a flow
source_programs: GenerativeComponents (transactions recorded in the DGN); Blender (Info editor operator log)
what_it_is: Run commands and tools with the pointer and get a flow of them.
